slides.title: Feet under hips, glutes on.
slides.body: Squeeze hard. It stops the lean before it starts.

slides.title: Ribs down, brace.
slides.body: Big breath, stack ribs over hips. No arch, then press.

slides.title: Grip just outside shoulders.
slides.body: Forearms vertical, elbows slightly in front of the bar.

slides.title: Head back, then through.
slides.body: Chin out of the way. Push your head through at the top.
